audience: teams that keep stock levels, items and folders in Simple Inventory

useCases.title: Find items that are low on stock
useCases.text: List the active items with their quantities. Check the recent low and out-of-stock events to see which items run out first.

useCases.title: Browse folders and the items in them
useCases.text: List the folders with their IDs and full paths. Then list the items to see the folder of each one.

useCases.title: Look up one item by ID or SKU
useCases.text: Get one item by its ID or SKU, archived items included. For a variant group, read its variations too.

useCases.title: Take units out of stock for an order
useCases.text: Remove units from one item's stock for an order. Pass an idempotency key, so a retry cannot remove the units twice.

useCases.title: Update stock for many items at once
useCases.text: Change the stock of up to 100 items in one request, for example after a physical count. The reply lists any failed changes.

useCases.title: Send inventory events to an order system
useCases.text: Subscribe a URL you own to one event type. Read the recent events to test your handler with real data.
